snippet.title: Doggy Don't Care | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Big news: Doggy Don’t Care will let you dress your mischievous pup up in adorable costumes! Know what the name for these is? It’s pawjamas. Sure, there’s already a lot to love about this slapstick chaos simulator starring a naughty pug having the absolute time of their life, but pawjamas, people!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438180/Doggy_Dont_Care/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
